findings.defect_1_refund_clamping: FIXED: packages/shared/src/finance/taxDeduction.ts was clamping amounts with Math.max(0, ...), causing refunds to be ignored or treated as positive income. Added isTaxDeductionRefund, net kopeck subtraction per category, and normalizePaymentsForTaxCertificate.
findings.defect_2_timezone_shifts: FIXED: raw new Date(p.dateIso).getFullYear() was causing midnight payments (2024-12-31T23:59:59Z, 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z) to shift calendar years depending on local timezone. Replaced with extractTaxYearFromDate everywhere.
findings.defect_3_api_builder_bloat: FIXED: apps/api/src/services/fns/fnsKnd1151156Builder.ts was a 346-line duplicate of ndflXmlGenerator.ts with synthetic fallbacks. Collapsed into a 60-line SSOT facade delegating to @dental/shared.
findings.defect_4_web_order_dependent_refunds: FIXED: apps/web/src/components/documents/taxCertificateEngine.ts was deducting refunds inline with Math.max(0, code01 - refund), which lost the refund if it occurred before payments in iteration order. Fixed to accumulate gross and refunds and net at end.
findings.defect_5_web_math_duplication: FIXED: apps/web/src/components/finance/taxDeductionEngine.ts had 350 lines of duplicate aggregation math. Refactored to delegate directly to @dental/shared.
findings.defect_6_xml_year_payments_netting: FIXED: In packages/shared/src/finance/taxDeduction.ts and familyTaxBatchEngine.ts, XML generators were using raw .filter() on payments, causing unnetted original amounts (e.g. 100,000 instead of 80,000 net) to be printed in receipt tables while summary declared net amount. Switched to normalizePaymentsForTaxCertificate.
findings.defect_7_footer_button_labels: FIXED: TaxDeductionModalFooter used informal labels instead of statutory references. Updated to 'Печать справки КНД 1151156 (А4)' and 'Выгрузить XML (ТКС)'.
findings.defect_8_autonomy_debt_block: FIXED: apps/api/src/services/documents/ndflTaxService.ts had a hard block refusing tax certificates for patients with unpaid balances for unrelated visits. Converted to a non-blocking warning per Art. 219 NK RF and Mandates 8e/8n.
findings.defect_9_ui_orphan_wiring: FIXED: FinanceTaxDeductionCard had no callback wired in FinancePlanning. Added onOpenTaxCertificateModal in FinancePlanning, added 'Справка для вычета (ФНС)' in FinanceToolbar options menu, and wired modal in FinanceView.
findings.defect_10_documents_tab_modal_empty_prop: FIXED: DocumentModalsContainer rendered TaxDeductionCertificateModal without patient/clinic props. Forwarded activePatient, clinicProfileDraft, and activeDoctor, plus added auto-fetch from /api/documents/tax-deduction/preview/:patientId when opened by patientId.
